title: Act: Implement the JSON execution store and startup recovery
description: Implement the store and recovery packages; no tests here.
acceptance_criteria: recovery.Run resumes or marks unfinished executions and clears stale locks

steps.symbol: new: Execution, Store, Save, Load, List
steps.action: Define Status constants QUEUED, RUNNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, FAILED, COMPLETED, RECOVERING. Execution{ID, World, Round string; Status Status; Attempt int; CostUSD float64; Error string; StartedAt, UpdatedAt time.Time} with json tags. Store{Dir string; Now func() time.Time}. Save sets UpdatedAt=Now(), validates ID with a regexp ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (no '..'), marshals indented JSON and writes via CreateTemp+Rename in Dir. Load(id) returns fs.ErrNotExist-wrapping error when missing. List returns every *.json sorted by ID, ignoring *.report.json
steps.expected: Round trip preserves all fields; unsafe ID returns an error

steps.action: Options{Store *state.Store; LockPath string; MaxRetries int; Alive func(pid int) bool; Log *slog.Logger}. Run(ctx) ([]Result, error): if LockPath exists and lock.Owner content is 'pid:<n>' with Alive(n) false, os.Remove it. For each List() execution with Status RUNNING or QUEUED: if Attempt < MaxRetries set Status QUEUED and Error 'resumed after restart' else set Status RECOVERING and Error 'interrupted; attempts exhausted'; Save; append Result{ID, Action resumed|marked}. Log each at Info. Leave other statuses unchanged
steps.code: type Result struct{ ID, Action string }
steps.expected: Results list one entry per unfinished execution
